name: RotomPC
description: A Pokémon-inspired PC terminal experience featuring a Pokédex, social interactions, trainer profiles, an AI chatbot, a virtual buddy simulation, and administrative moderation tools. Designed with a responsive interface for desktop and mobile devices.
highlights: AI-powered chatbot and virtual pokemon buddy simulation

name: PathForward Web
description: A web-based administrative platform supporting the PathForward mobile application, with comprehensive workflows for user management, job role management, system administration, reporting, and other core platform operations.

name: PathForward Mobile App
description: An AI-powered career-development mobile platform that helps job seekers identify suitable IT career paths, complete structured assessments, follow personalized skill roadmaps, access verified learning resources, and track their progress toward career readiness.

name: Trainex
description: An interactive web-based train driver's console simulator developed as an ongoing capstone project for railway engineering education. Features virtual train controls, acceleration and braking simulation, emergency brake functionality, passenger door operations, and Arduino-based microcontroller emulation.
highlights: Emergency braking and passenger door controls
Responsive interface for desktop and mobile

preview.alt: Trainex interactive train driver console simulator

name: Angono Giants
description: A Filipino folklore-inspired 2D arcade defense game featuring Higantes giants and village protection gameplay. Players defend their village against waves of enemies, earn points, survive increasingly challenging levels, and unlock new stages. Developed as a native Android game with animated pixel-art visuals, interactive touch controls, Firebase-powered player progress and leaderboards, and an HTML5 browser adaptation.
highlights: Filipino tradition-inspired from the Angono's Festival with gameplay featuring Higantes
Wave-based enemy spawning, combat, and progressive difficulty
Interactive touch controls, scoring, and survival mechanics
Animated pixel-art environments and cinematic game transitions
Firebase authentication, player progression, and leaderboards
Android application with an HTML5 browser adaptation
